identity.title: [v0.92][Runtime] Wire governed Adaptive Learning into resident execution

values.summary: Bind a FastWork worktree, implement a production resident adaptive-learning module and actual resident-cycle integration proof, then publish only after focused code proof and fresh exact review pass.

steps.action: Validate live issue scope, dependency gates, typed initialization, and design readiness.
Bind #449 in a FastWork worktree and implement resident-cycle production input mapping to execute_governed_adaptive_learning without fabricated capability/profile handles.
Implement MutationGate-only accepted adaptation application and non-mutating terminal evidence for rejection/cancellation/fail-closed cases.
Implement restart/rehydration continuity and tamper/rollback/gap/lineage fail-closed behavior.
Run focused production-path proof through actual resident cycle accepted/rejected/restart/deterministic continuation and update feature/evidence truth only after proof passes.

invariants: No graph/state mutation occurs outside MutationGate.
Dependency-gated capability/profile handles are not fabricated.
Rejected/cancelled/invalid proposals retain terminal evidence and make no mutation.
Restart/rehydration cannot replay or duplicate accepted mutations.
Private profile/provider content is not leaked in evidence.
risks: Sibling capability/profile production handles may not be terminal when #449 implementation reaches AC2.
Resident-cycle test proof may expose broader runtime fixture coupling.
Durable adaptive history may need bounded API changes to avoid replay/duplication.
Feature/evidence docs must not overclaim production integration before exact proof.
stop_conditions: Capability/profile production handles are unavailable and no truthful dependency-gated implementation path remains.
A proposed fix requires absorbing #446 ACC tool-actuation authority.
Production-path proof collapses to fixture-only or benchmark-only evidence.
Required source changes would touch unrelated #341/#343/#84/#122/#251 scope.
replan_triggers: Sibling capability/profile production handles land with a materially different API.
Resident-cycle proof requires touching #446 ACC tool execution.
MutationGate or durable history contracts fail the focused integration proof.
